topic: Maki's lack of cursed energy makes her immune to domain expansions in chapter 198
title: Why No Domain Expansion Can Hit Maki Zenin
description: Naoya's domain should have been a sure thing. Here's the rule in chapter 198 that makes Maki Zenin the one sorcerer a domain can't pin down. Do you think Sukuna has an answer?
comment: Can Sukuna beat Maki without a sure hit domain, or does she win by default? Pick one.
end_text: WHERE HER POWER REALLY CAME FROM

lines.text: Naoya Zenin cast a domain on Maki Zenin, and it did nothing.

shot.fallback: huge dark barrier closing around a lone woman

lines.text: A domain is supposed to be the one attack you can't dodge.

shot.fallback: glowing barrier forming around two fighters

lines.text: So why does chapter 198 say Maki is just immune?

shot.fallback: calm woman standing inside a glowing dome

lines.text: First, a domain is a barrier made of cursed energy, and Maki has none.

shot.fallback: woman surrounded by empty air, no aura

lines.text: Barriers treat her like a building. They just flow around her.

shot.fallback: force field passing around a stone pillar

lines.text: Second, the sure hit has nothing to lock onto, because there's no cursed energy to find.

shot.fallback: projectiles sliding past a motionless woman

lines.text: The best counter is that Naoya's speed should still beat her. It didn't.

shot.fallback: blond man blurring across a ruined colony

lines.text: She studied his technique in chapter 151, then took him apart in chapter 197.

shot.fallback: woman standing over a defeated spirit

lines.text: So the domain that was meant to end her was the weakest card he held.

shot.fallback: angry spirit staring at a calm woman

lines.text: But being invisible to a domain doesn't explain how she got there. That took a twin and a rule.

shot.fallback: twin sisters facing each other in soft light

lines.text: A domain couldn't hit Maki, and that's why Naoya Zenin cast a domain on Maki Zenin and it did nothing.

shot.fallback: angry spirit staring at a calm woman

self_check.hook: Opens on the surprising result: a domain did nothing.
self_check.loop: Final line flows back into line 1.
